volterra.estimate: Every slow/fast derivative word of total length m satisfies ||D^m w||_infinity <= W^(m+1)*(B*S)^powers[m].
premises: The SAME original homogeneous initial datum is independent of all slow coordinates.
Every actual mixed coefficient derivative of order j has induced infinity norm <=(B*S)^matrixPowers[j].
volterra.proof: Induct on total order. A word with a fast derivative is handled by the differentiated ODE. A purely slow word uses Duhamel and its zero initial derivative; count all subsets of each length with binomial(m,j). W^(m-j+2)<=W^(m+1) when j>=1. The interval contributes one B*S. No order-dependent growth exp(L) is introduced.

mixed.base: B_m>=max(Bnorm,C_(m+2),(m+2)!,Lmax,2^128), fixed independently of ell, labels and representative; S=ell^2>=1.

sourcePremises.background: Every original slow derivative of F,G through m+2 is bounded by C_(m+2) on the same enlarged source annulus, for the same common recursive cutoff sequence.
sourcePremises.normal: n=(x0-v*H_R,p/R,pz-epsilon*v*H_Z), H=p*F+pz*G. Both H_R and H_Z retain all mixed slow derivatives. Frozen p,pz,x0 and their source scales, R^-1 and reference data obey the unchanged Bnorm bounds. epsilon<=1 and 0<=v<=L<=Lmax*S. Leibniz and derivatives of 1/R then give |D^j n_i|<=(B_m*S)^(j+16); the extra power16 retains all finite products and sums.
sourcePremises.positiveFloors: The unchanged source has |n_tan|,|n|>=Bnorm^-2, |c0|>=Bnorm^-1 and sqrt(1+sref^2)>=1. These imply the weaker (B_m*S) floors used by the exact reciprocal/sqrt recurrence.
sourcePremises.frozenReference: P, c0, lambda0, sref, dref and every frozen representative/carrier are slow independent inside each fixed-label chart; v derivatives of the reference data are retained.
sourcePremises.stable: The actual original matrix has mu_infinity(M)<=(2E+Ed)/S; hence its propagator is bounded by fixed W=exp((2E+Ed)*Lmax). Use the original positive Gaussian envelope P(v).

mixed.estimate: For every fixed total slow/fast order m, ||D^m t||_infinity <= W^(m+1)*(B_m*S)^powers.t[m]*P(v). At positive temporal-cutoff derivatives, P(v)<=exp(-a*ell^2) with the SAME a>0.

curlRows.rule: Every derivative of a(R)*D_xi C and C/R uses its full Leibniz sum. The same source K controls all derivatives of a/epsilon^-kappa_s and 1/R required at this fixed order.
Every derivative of a(R)*D_xi C and C/R uses its full Leibniz sum. The same source K controls all derivatives of a/epsilon^-kappa_s and 1/R required at this fixed order.

weighted.base: For each fixed m choose one K_m>=2 dominating the original B_(m+1), W^(m+2), Haar-length constant, d_star^-1, c_y^-1/2, all target jet constants through m+1 and original cutoff/chart constants. It is independent of ell and labels.
premises: Original homogeneous t mixed jets obey the retained mixed Gaussian ledger with the SAME Gaussian P(v)<=1.
Original H has its literal Haar/cutoff integrals, ci*Ls=2r0, |det H|>=d_star/S, and each actual positive y_j>=c_y*zeta.

premises.frameBounds: N,K and N_a,K_a are oriented orthonormal pairs; |K_a-K|,|N_a-N|<=Ef/S, |s_a-s|<=Es/S

cone.inwardProof: r_prime=E21+(-2*lambda+E22-E11)*r-E12*r^2. At r=+beta, beta=4E/(lambdaFloor*S)<=1, r_prime<=(E/S)*(1-8+2*beta+beta^2)<=-4E/S; the lower boundary is symmetric. E=0 gives r=0 exactly.
cone.positivity: z_plus is the positive exponential solution of its scalar equation after the invariant ratio is inserted; x=(1+r)*z_plus>0.

gaussian.continuousProof: u>=2 and u/2<=|s|<=3u/2 give lambdaLower/(2u) <= -Ls*(lambda-dref)_prime <= 7*lambdaUpper/u <= 15*lambdaUpper/u. The lower bound uses (5/4)^3<4. Integrate from the exact zero at v=Ls/2.

mass.lowerProof: For |v-Ls/2|<=sqrt(Ls)/(10a), a=max(1,2*gaussianUpper), psi=1 and P^2>=exp(-1/100)>1/3. Integrate over the interval of length sqrt(Ls)/(5a).
mass.upperProof: Extend the nonnegative integrand to the real line and set w=2*gaussianLower*(v-Ls/2)^2/Ls. The absolute first moment equals amplitudeUpper^2/(2*gaussianLower).

columns.normalizedRows: C_1sign=-(N dot H_sign)/(Ac*h_sign); C_2sign=(K dot H_sign)/(u*h_sign)
columns.tangentProof: Tangent-row error <=Es/(u*S)+(2+5*Ac/u)*Ef/S. Both reference normalized rows differ from their midpoint value by at most |v-Ls/2|/Ls; the factor u cancels.

selection.bandProof: ell>=ellMinimum>=Sminimum>=1 implies S=ell^2>=Sminimum. For ell>=(64/h)^2, log(3)+4log(ell)-(h*log(2)/2)*ell<0, using log(2)>=1/2 and log(ell)<=sqrt(ell). Hence S^2*(epsilon+epsilon^2+k^-1)<=3ell^4*2^(-h*ell/2)<1.

primitive.C2: The authenticated c_n finite block and diagonal induction are unchanged for b_n>=c_n, since the Euler cutoff derivative bounds do not depend on the scale. Every positive coefficient remains in the actual finite active sum.
primitive.normal: Same-box chart paths, full leading C2, and error<=C2*epsilon^2 give each completed-leading frozen jet error<=B^5/S^3. Rounding contributes at most1/k, n=(x0-v*H_R,p/R,pz-epsilon*v*H_Z), and n_prime=(-H_R,0,-epsilon*H_Z). With v<=Lmax*S all normal and slope errors are<=B^12/S.
primitive.frame: The actual source lower bounds Bs>B^-1, |n_tangent|>=B^-2 and the executed original FramePowerLedger give each operator, damping, unit-frame and slope error<=B^256/S. The full pressure term and B_prime are retained.
primitive.logarithmicNorm: wMatrix=diag(0,-2*lambda)+E_actual-(d-dref)I. Its infinity logarithmic norm is at most(2*E+Ed)/S, hence every forward propagator is bounded by exp((2*E+Ed)*Lmax), independently of S.
primitive.allLabels: Each label uses its own original representative, rounded carrier, actual completed fields, Volterra matrix and H. The proof depends only on these uniform source inequalities and the original same-box hypotheses, not on the default materialized band.

primitives.fieldJetDifference: <=B^5/S^3, relaxed only after the n primitive is built

cone.inwardProof: r_prime=E21+(-2*lambda+E22-E11)*r-E12*r^2. At r=+beta, beta=4E/(lambdaFloor*S)<=1, r_prime<=(E/S)*(1-8+2*beta+beta^2)<=-4E/S; the lower boundary is symmetric. E=0 gives r=0 exactly.

gaussian.continuousProof: u>=2 and u/2<=|s|<=3u/2 give lambdaLower/(2u) <= -Ls*(lambda-dref)_prime <= 7*lambdaUpper/u <= 15*lambdaUpper/u. The lower bound uses (5/4)^3<4. Integrate from the exact zero at v=Ls/2.

mass.lowerProof: For |v-Ls/2|<=sqrt(Ls)/(10a), a=max(1,2*gaussianUpper), psi=1 and P^2>=exp(-1/100)>1/3. Integrate over the interval of length sqrt(Ls)/(5a).
mass.upperProof: Extend the nonnegative integrand to the real line and set w=2*gaussianLower*(v-Ls/2)^2/Ls. The absolute first moment equals amplitudeUpper^2/(2*gaussianLower).

projection.pressureRetained: Reference n-prime is zero only in the algebraic reference comparison. Actual n-prime and B-prime remain in the source operator and its error estimate.
projection.determinantIdentity: det(H)=-Ac*u*mass_plus*mass_minus*det(C). Positive masses and det(C)>0 give negative physical determinant.

threshold.gamma: Explicit sufficient choice qbig=qStar, ell0=ellMinimum+6. For each integer ell>=ell0, Q=2^-ell and q=Q*s, s in[1/2,2], imply q<=qStar/2<qStar. This chooses a permitted smaller domain; it does not infer the unknown historical numerical Gamma.

sourceDomain.representative: The original leading reference at the chosen point of that very same box.

primitiveProof.C2: The authenticated c_n finite block and diagonal induction are unchanged for b_n>=c_n, since the Euler cutoff derivative bounds do not depend on the scale. Every positive coefficient remains in the actual finite active sum.
primitiveProof.normal: Same-box chart paths, full leading C2, and error<=C2*epsilon^2 give each completed-leading frozen jet error<=B^5/S^3. Rounding contributes at most1/k, n=(x0-v*H_R,p/R,pz-epsilon*v*H_Z), and n_prime=(-H_R,0,-epsilon*H_Z). With v<=Lmax*S all normal and slope errors are<=B^12/S.
primitiveProof.frame: The actual source lower bounds Bs>B^-1, |n_tangent|>=B^-2 and the executed original FramePowerLedger give each operator, damping, unit-frame and slope error<=B^256/S. The full pressure term and B_prime are retained.
primitiveProof.logarithmicNorm: wMatrix=diag(0,-2*lambda)+E_actual-(d-dref)I. Its infinity logarithmic norm is at most(2*E+Ed)/S, hence every forward propagator is bounded by exp((2*E+Ed)*Lmax), independently of S.
primitiveProof.allLabels: Each label uses its own original representative, rounded carrier, actual completed fields, Volterra matrix and H. The proof depends only on these uniform source inequalities and the original same-box hypotheses, not on the default materialized band.

positivity.derivation: The original S14 lower |T0|>=min(C^-11,Renv^-8)*zeta, chart factor>=1/4, same-box -unit(T0) dot N>Renv^-33 and Ac<Renv^22 imply targetScale>=Renv^-128*zeta. The actual positive mass is at most uniformUpper.

naturalSeriesKernel.meaning: Limit of the exact generated radial coefficient partial sums. Each finite partial sum is a complete A.21/g expression graph. The explicit B_rho tail tends to zero.

expressionKernel.meaning: Shared explicit expression bodies with mixed automatic differentiation. Every requested jet is a derivative of the retained actual body, never a caller-supplied coefficient.

targetWeightedJetNormRecipe.method: Copy the original factor bodies with exact operation-by-operation provenance. On overlapping collars use the regular inner/outer factors and their anchored FTC norms; on the intervening compact rectangle use the original full target divided by positive zeta. Apply the exact slow coefficient recurrence and Gaussian derivative recurrence. No numerical division at a flat endpoint.

smoothSquareRoot.sourceOuterFactor: exp(-2/delta^2)*delta^(-3/2)*sqrt(H^-1*bbar), bbar includes delta^6 in its axial component and s^(-A-1/2)
smoothSquareRoot.allFiniteJetProof: C_m and the protected frame denominators give M_j,B_j polynomial in S. Stable Duhamel gives w_j and t_j/P polynomial in S. H_j follows by fixed-interval differentiation, exact Haar factor and Ls/S bounds. Differentiate H*y=T, then sigma^2=y after removing the actual edge scalar. det H>=d*/S and the regular positive inverse coefficient lower give polynomial S bounds at every fixed order. The original Gaussian scalar absorbs every finite endpoint pole.
smoothSquareRoot.supports: All positive Fn/Un end at the common interior Xplus, so the outer source agrees with the complete leading heat body. At the inner boundary every active positive correction is retained; the full C_m, not an order-one-only bound, controls its jets.

proof.domain: An original active point has Xa<X<Xb, 1/2<s<2, T>=0 and every fixed mesh offset strictly between -3/4 and3/4. On positive time T>0; the original T=0 limit has a positive-time interior in the same integer mesh box.
proof.radialProjection: There is an interior admissible radius iff max(1/2,max(0,Rl)^2/(2Xb))<s<min(2,Ru^2/(2Xa)). This uses Ru>0, automatically supplied by an active point.
proof.axialProjection: For T in(max(0,Tl),Tu), F(s,Z)=s-Z^2*s^(2h) meets this interval with s in(sLower,sUpper) iff (sLower-Tu)/sLower^(2h)<Z^2<(sUpper-max(0,Tl))/sUpper^(2h).
proof.monotonicity: The upper Z^2 bound is<=sUpper^(1-2h)<=2^(1-2h). Thus on1/2<=s<=2, partial_s F>=1-2h*4^(1-2h)>1-8h>1/2 because the original h<1/16.
proof.signChoice: Intersect the open Z box with the two open sign intervals. If the lower squared bound is negative, omitting the single point0 cannot remove a nonempty open intersection. Choose the negative interval iff its width is positive; otherwise choose the positive one. Its midpoint is strictly interior.
proof.timeChoice: The two endpoint values of strictly increasing F leave a nonempty open intersection with(max(0,Tl),Tu). Its midpoint gives a unique original root strictly between sLower and sUpper.
proof.radialChoice: At that root, (Rl,Ru) intersects(sqrt(2Xa*s),sqrt(2Xb*s)) in a nonempty open interval. Its midpoint is strictly inside the original shell and same mesh box.
proof.sameBoxDistance: Each of the three coordinate differences to any other active point in the box is<3/(2ell^6), so Euclidean distance<3sqrt(3)/(2ell^6)<4/ell^6=4/S^3.
proof.boundaryOnly: If the closed box and closed shell only touch without an active interior, the original slow factor or shell flat extension is identically zero at every possible point. The complete source term returns zero at its OUTER guard, before any representative, inverse, root or Volterra evaluation.
proof.frozenChoices: All max/min and the sign choice depend only on ell and the integer mesh label. They are fixed before every R/Z/T derivative; no derivative of a nearest-cell map or a residual-dependent choice is taken.
proof.originalFreedom: This specifies one allowed common choice of representatives for the new global M3 family. It does not assert equality to a different previously selected local witness wave.

A purely slow word uses Duhamel and its zero initial derivative; count all subsets of each length with binomial(m,j). W^(m-j+2)<=W^(m+1) when j>=1. The interval contributes one B*S. sourcePremises.normal: n=(x0-v*H_R,p/R,pz-epsilon*v*H_Z), H=p*F+pz*G. Both H_R and H_Z retain all mixed slow derivatives. Frozen p,pz,x0 and their source scales, R^-1 and reference data obey the unchanged Bnorm bounds. epsilon<=1 and 0<=v<=L<=Lmax*S. Leibniz and derivatives of 1/R then give |D^j n_i|<=(B_m*S)^(j+16); the extra power16 retains all finite products and sums.
sourcePremises.positiveFloors: The unchanged source has |n_tan|,|n|>=Bnorm^-2, |c0|>=Bnorm^-1 and sqrt(1+sref^2)>=1. These imply the weaker (B_m*S) floors used by the exact reciprocal/sqrt recurrence.
sourcePremises.frozenReference: P, c0, lambda0, sref, dref and every frozen representative/carrier are slow independent inside each fixed-label chart; v derivatives of the reference data are retained.
sourcePremises.stable: The actual original matrix has mu_infinity(M)<=(2E+Ed)/S; hence its propagator is bounded by fixed W=exp((2E+Ed)*Lmax). Use the original positive Gaussian envelope P(v).

mixed.estimate: For every fixed total slow/fast order m, ||D^m t||_infinity <= W^(m+1)*(B_m*S)^powers.t[m]*P(v). At positive temporal-cutoff derivatives, P(v)<=exp(-a*ell^2) with the SAME a>0.

curlRows.rule: Every derivative of a(R)*D_xi C and C/R uses its full Leibniz sum. The same source K controls all derivatives of a/epsilon^-kappa_s and 1/R required at this fixed order.

weighted.base: For each fixed m choose one K_m>=2 dominating the original B_(m+1), W^(m+2), Haar-length constant, d_star^-1, c_y^-1/2, all target jet constants through m+1 and original cutoff/chart constants. It is independent of ell and labels.
premises: Original homogeneous t mixed jets obey the retained mixed Gaussian ledger with the SAME Gaussian P(v)<=1.
Original H has its literal Haar/cutoff integrals, ci*Ls=2r0, |det H|>=d_star/S, and each actual positive y_j>=c_y*zeta.
|D^j Tbar|<=K_m*zeta*delta^(-targetPoles[j]) for every needed j on the same complete source annulus.
The original cutoff slow mesh has scale ell^6=S^3; transverse cutoffs and the reference time cutoff have source-only derivative constants, with Ls>=1.
The full-curl fast radial coefficient obeys |D_R^j a(R)|<=sourceConstant_j*epsilon^(-kappa_s), kappa_s=1/100000, and 1/k<=sqrt(epsilon).
weighted.inverseIdentity: D^m(H^-1)=-H^-1*sum_(j=1)^m binom(m,j)*(D^j H)*(D^(m-j)H^-1); matrix dimension2 is retained.

conclusion.amplitude: The original eta_beta*sqrt(epsilon)*sqrt(y)*chi*psi*t has coefficient class W_(1/2) with the displayed polynomial/pole bounds and Gaussian P.
conclusion.potential: The original n cross amplitude/(k|n|^2) has W_1 coefficients. A source-only 1/k factor cannot be lost.
conclusion.curl: The full normalized curl has the primary W_(1/2) coefficient plus a W_(1-kappa_s) remainder. Since kappa_s<1/2 and epsilon<=1, their absolute sum is bounded in W_(1/2) by curl[j].

degreeProgram.fullCurlIdentity: (weightedAmplitude+i*curlRemainder)*exp(i*k*Phi), after the actual moving-frame tangency identity.

haarRows.exactComparison: Here ratio=Q_ref/Q_label. All active labels have |ell_label-ell_ref|<=2, so S_label<=4*S_ref. The original X and both logarithmic boundary distances are unchanged.
haarRows.covarianceScope: The complete normalized auxiliary Haar covariance. The Y-dependent covariance before Haar still requires the two-column (xi,v) common-torus pullback derivative factors.

identity.arithmetic: Exact BigInt rational functions of the retained actual source operands, with explicit denominator clearing.

boundary.proof: 0<nu=ab/(a+b)<=min(a,b). If delta<1, sqrt(zeta)<=exp(-nu/(2delta^2)) and log(1/delta)<=1/delta. Complete the displayed nonnegative square. If delta=1 use sqrt(zeta)<=1. Keeping half the radial exponential instead gives all fixed vanishing orders at either edge.

bounds.boundMeaning: Finite positive expression constants, not floating-point values. Every row bounds all derivatives through that order on the actual same-box source domain.

originalSourcePrimitive.C2: The authenticated c_n finite block and diagonal induction are unchanged for b_n>=c_n, since the Euler cutoff derivative bounds do not depend on the scale. Every positive coefficient remains in the actual finite active sum.
originalSourcePrimitive.normal: Same-box chart paths, full leading C2, and error<=C2*epsilon^2 give each completed-leading frozen jet error<=B^5/S^3. Rounding contributes at most1/k, n=(x0-v*H_R,p/R,pz-epsilon*v*H_Z), and n_prime=(-H_R,0,-epsilon*H_Z). With v<=Lmax*S all normal and slope errors are<=B^12/S.
originalSourcePrimitive.frame: The actual source lower bounds Bs>B^-1, |n_tangent|>=B^-2 and the executed original FramePowerLedger give each operator, damping, unit-frame and slope error<=B^256/S. The full pressure term and B_prime are retained.
originalSourcePrimitive.logarithmicNorm: wMatrix=diag(0,-2*lambda)+E_actual-(d-dref)I. Its infinity logarithmic norm is at most(2*E+Ed)/S, hence every forward propagator is bounded by exp((2*E+Ed)*Lmax), independently of S.
originalSourcePrimitive.allLabels: Each label uses its own original representative, rounded carrier, actual completed fields, Volterra matrix and H. The proof depends only on these uniform source inequalities and the original same-box hypotheses, not on the default materialized band.

domain.referenceChart: The original (R,Z,T), with T>=0, q=Q_ref*s>0 and 1/2<=s<=2.
domain.exactPrefixProof: The actual common b_n is monotone. For n>=N+1, b_n*q>=1; the original time cutoff and all its derivatives are exactly zero, including at the flat endpoint.
domain.bandFloorProof: q<2^(-(ell0+4)) implies -log2(q)>ell0+4. Every active |ell+log2(q)|<3/4 therefore has ell>=ell0.
domain.compatibleAtlas: For any two prefix orders valid at this same q, every extra coefficient is exactly zero together with all derivatives. The backgrounds, phases, original matrices, Volterra solutions, H and fixed positive a coincide by ODE uniqueness. The actual monotone b_n>=2^n makes these prefix domains cover every q>0.

exactTail.proof: ell<=floor(log2(b_(N+1)))-1 implies b_(N+1)*2^(-ell-1)>=1. For q>=2^(-ell-1), every n>=N+1 has b_n*q>=1 and all original cutoff derivatives vanish.

coverage.proof: The next lower endpoint is floor(log2(b_(N+1))), exactly one more than this upper endpoint, apart from the common ell0 maximum. Since b_n>=2^n, the upper endpoints tend to infinity.

domain.sourceWindow: The concrete band includes every active coefficient through its certified cutoff window. Its first omitted term and every derivative vanish by the original selector; this one window is not claimed to cover every q.
domain.allBandRecipe: For each other valid prefix window run the same original selector, field, carrier, frame, exact Volterra and H construction. All norm constants here come from the same common family and are independent of the chosen window and discrete labels.
domain.classCoordinates: Fixed-label (R,Z,T,xi,v); representative, ell, mesh labels and rounded carriers are frozen before differentiation.
domain.wholeAnnulus: Xa<X<Xb, s in[1/2,2], eta in[-1,1] on the same original box. The actual positive weights extend smoothly by zero at both original flat edges.
domain.derivativeExecution: Every requested norm leaf is constructed. The private current has a separate finite slow-jet execution budget; the class proof does not assert that every high-order current derivative graph was materialized.
